hero.caption:
Basilan's landscape is, like a painting, filled with habitats. From rainforests to coasts lined with mangroves and from hills to towering mountains the islands diverse geography creates a wide range of ecosystems. This diversity provides homes for species to thrive and adapt forming a tapestry of life. Basilan is known as a biodiversity hotspot since many species can only be found within its boundaries. The islands isolation has resulted in the development of plants and animals making it a center for species. However their protection, in a changing world poses challenges that need attention. Loss, overexploitation and climate change are threats faced by Basilans treasures. Nevertheless there are individuals and organizations working together to safeguard Basilans heritage through sustainable practices, education and advocacy.
Basilan Island, Philippines

images.caption: Located at 6°37'38.96"N 121°58'24.91"E Barangay Maligue, Isabela City, Basilan is one of the remaining densely forested areas in Basilan province and probably the only one in Isabela City. Home to diversities in flora and fauna the Local Government Unit recognized this as protected area. In 2020 the first ever inventory of birds was done in ICFP at least 22 species of bird were documented. Among those documented are Rofous Paradise-Fly-Catcher, Mindanao Boobook, Blacked eyed Monarch, Blacked eyed Oriole, and the Mindanao Hornbill. The discovery these birds has put ICFP in one of the world’s birding community. In the photo a fellow photographer is taking photos of Flying Foxes resting on critically endangered endemic Basilan Yakal trees (Hopia basilanicus).

images.filename: MV Lady Mary Joy 3 Basilan fire.jpg
images.caption: A Philippine Coast Guard ship tries to put out the blaze that swept through MV Lady Mary Joy 3, which caught fire off Basilan province as it was sailing to Sulu on Wednesday night (March 29, 2023). At least 29 died and 17 were missing from the fire that reportedly started in an air-conditioned cabin in the lower deck.
